{{Quote|I'd like to work for the police force.|A spacer, to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]]|<ref name="SWG:TMPW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - More Police Work|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Royal Security Police Force''', ('''RSPF''') or simply known as the '''Police Force''', was the stranded [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|territorial police force]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
[[File:Naboo_police.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Naboo police officer.]]
Naboo police officers were present in the [[City/Legends|cities]] of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:AED" /> The Police Force was present in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Individual [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guards]] who worked as sentries and patrolmen supplemented the police on behalf of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]].<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Police work sounds fine to me.|A spacer, to Captain Typho|<ref name="SWG:TPW" />}}
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Theed police forcibly removed migrant workers who staged protests at the [[Palace Courtyard/Legends|Palace Courtyard]], aiming to highlight their poor working conditions.<ref name="insideII">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Police Force [[Royal Security Forces police raid on Mauler base|raided]] the [[Maulers|Mauler]] [[Mauler Stronghold|base]] near [[Keren/Legends|Keren]].<ref name="SWG:TPW" /> Soon after, the police [[Capture of Doogal Belstar|eliminated]] [[Doogal Belstar]], the leader of the Maulers and most wanted man on Naboo.<ref name="SWG:TMPW" /> Soon after, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sundria Khartoor|Khartoor]] of the Violent Crimes Division was tasked to arrest the murderer [[Hunnos Jarkey]].<ref name="SWG:FaEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find an Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref>
